scientific_integrity: The source paper provides the definition, broader conjecture, and asymptotic theorem; the finite six-chromatic vertex-critical conclusion is separately checked using the embedded verifier. Pre-existing Schrijver criticality for a single cycle is credited.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion concerns only the finite disjointness graph of independent three-sets in the union of a nine-cycle and one isolated vertex. Five-uncolorability is proved by fully exhaustive finite computation and six vertex-deletion orbit witnesses; no larger-parameter statement, edge-criticality or independent proof audit is asserted. The foundational preprint reports unnamed computational tests, leaving residual priority uncertainty.
title: A six-chromatic vertex-critical generalized Kneser graph at the first isolated-cycle boundary
